_note: Deliberately small, conservative demo rules for widely documented combinations. Not a substitute for a clinical interaction database.

pairs.title: Bleeding risk
pairs.detail: Warfarin with aspirin raises the risk of serious bleeding. Do not stop either medicine yourself; ask the prescriber to confirm this combination is intended.

pairs.title: Bleeding risk
pairs.detail: Painkillers like ibuprofen can increase bleeding on warfarin. Check with the prescriber before taking both.

pairs.title: Bleeding risk
pairs.detail: Painkillers like diclofenac can increase bleeding on warfarin. Check with the prescriber before taking both.

pairs.title: Two painkillers of the same type
pairs.detail: Both are anti-inflammatory painkillers (NSAIDs). Taking two together raises stomach and kidney risk. Ask whether both are really needed.

pairs.title: Dangerous blood pressure drop
pairs.detail: Nitrates with sildenafil can cause a severe drop in blood pressure. Contact the prescriber before taking both.

pairs.title: High potassium risk
pairs.detail: This pair can raise blood potassium. It is sometimes intended, but needs blood tests. Ask the prescriber about monitoring.

pairs.title: High potassium risk
pairs.detail: This pair can raise blood potassium. It is sometimes intended, but needs blood tests. Ask the prescriber about monitoring.

pairs.title: Muscle damage risk
pairs.detail: Clarithromycin can raise simvastatin levels and cause muscle damage. Ask the prescriber whether to pause the statin during the course.
